# David Carvalho — Personal Portfolio

> Personal portfolio website of David Carvalho, a backend / software developer,
> showcasing projects, experience, and background. Built with Astro, TypeScript,
> and Tailwind CSS, with a few React islands for interactive UI.

Astro static site with React islands for interactive components. Requires Node.js >= 18
and pnpm (enforced via an `only-allow` preinstall hook). The contact form posts to
Formspree; no other external services or API keys are required.

## Site

- Home: animated hero and skills list
- Experience: data-driven timeline (`src/data/experience.ts`)
- Projects: homepage preview plus a dedicated `/projects` page with category
  filtering and expandable case-study detail modals (`src/data/projects.ts`)
- Contact: Formspree-backed form

## Stack

- **Astro** -- site framework
- **TypeScript** -- type checking across `.astro` and `.tsx` files
- **Tailwind CSS** -- utility-first styling
- **React** -- interactive islands (LetterGlitch animation, SkillsList)
- **Formspree** -- contact form backend
- **Montserrat** (Fontsource variable) -- primary typeface
- **OGL** -- WebGL utility used by the LetterGlitch canvas effect
- **pnpm** -- package manager (enforced via `only-allow`)

## Credits

- Based on the "Dark Minimal" theme by Gothsec (https://github.com/Gothsec/dark-minimal), used under the MIT License.
- LetterGlitch component from ReactBits (https://www.reactbits.dev/).
